propositions: Container restart during an in-flight code review (260-911s duration) causes premature drain timeout (45s) that cancels the review worker and votes fail-closed LLM-Review -1, blocking the existing backfill reconciler recovery mechanism.

The shutdown drain timeout (45s) is undersized relative to the per-review timeout (1200s); raising DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 1200 and stop_grace_period to 1320s enables the drain to wait for in-flight reviews to complete.

Transient git-fetch hangs (burning the 300s timeout) cause review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, and gate-disabled gaps that are converted to fail-closed votes, preventing reconciler re-drive; deferring the vote (posting no vote) for retryable gap_reason values leaves changes vote-less so reconciler backfill re-drives them.

A bounded escalation cap (default 3 attempts per change/revision) converts repeated retryable gaps to fail-closed -1 with exhaustion note and VOTER_ERROR marker to surface the alarm, preventing infinite reconciler loops.

Terminal outcomes (finding, indeterminate, gate-disabled) continue voting fail-closed -1; only retryable infrastructure failures (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, process teardown) defer the vote.

The review_attempts ledger (keyed by change_id and revision, shaped for contributor re-trigger reset) tracks attempt count and enables restart of the retry budget without duplicating reconciler state.
